user.title: TV Picture Mode
user.description: Switches the TV's Picture Mode (Vivid/Movie) via its own on-screen quick-toggle, and tracks the live Picture Mode — including changes made with the physical remote — via a permanent logcat connection to the TV.

data_description.media_player_entity_id: The same adb-capable media_player entity already used for adb commands on this TV.
data_description.host: The TV's IP address on your network, e.g. 192.168.1.50 — needed because this integration opens its own direct connection to the TV to stream its log, instead of going through the androidtv integration.
data_description.port: The TV's ADB port. Almost always 5555, the same one already used to control it.
data_description.adbkey_path: Defaults to the same ADB key the androidtv integration already uses and has authorized on this TV — leave as-is unless you have a reason to use a different one.

set_mode.name: Set TV picture mode
set_mode.description: Switches the target TV's Picture Mode to Vivid or Movie, using the TV's own on-screen quick-toggle. The menu flashes on screen for roughly a second while this runs.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Which Picture Mode to switch to.

refresh.name: Refresh TV picture mode
refresh.description: Forces an immediate read of the TV's current Picture Mode without changing it — useful right after Home Assistant restarts. Not needed otherwise: the sensor updates on its own, live, from the TV's own log, including changes made with the physical remote.
